headline: NPA leader Meghmallar Basu put on life support at DMCH
summary: The former DU student union president and National People's Action leader is in critical condition after an apparent overdose of sleeping pills.
details: Meghmallar Basu, a central leader of the National People's Action (NPA) and former president of the Bangladesh Chhatra Union's Dhaka University branch, has been placed on life support.
caption:
A former DU student leader is fighting for his life on life support at Dhaka Medical College Hospital.

Meghmallar Basu, a central leader of the National People's Action (NPA) and former president of the Bangladesh Chhatra Union's Dhaka University branch, has been placed on life support.

Source: Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune
tweet: NPA leader Meghmallar Basu has been put on life support at DMCH after his condition deteriorated following an apparent overdose of sleeping pills. #Bangladesh #Dhaka #BreakingNews

headline_marked: 50 injured, including ASP, in [[clash between two villages]] in Brahmanbaria
headline: 50 injured, including ASP, in clash between two villages in Brahmanbaria
summary: Residents of two villages engaged in a four-hour bloody clash using flashlights and local weapons in the dark of night.
details: A violent clash broke out between residents of two villages in Brahmanbaria, leaving around 50 people injured. Among the injured are an Additional Superintendent of Police (ASP) and a local Union Parishad Chairman.
The confrontation lasted for four hours during the night, with participants using flashlights to navigate the darkness while wielding local weapons.
The clash occurred in the Sarail area of Brahmanbaria, resulting in significant casualties from both sides.
Police and local authorities intervened to bring the situation under control after the prolonged fighting.
